capabilities: Count words between start/end comment markers or under a named heading
Exclude frontmatter, comments, Markdown syntax and link URLs from the count
Run stopwatch, countdown and per-note session timers in a sidebar panel
Show a live count inline via a wordcount code block
Display the active note's count in the desktop status bar
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; manual installation from a release is described. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The README notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: counts words only inside a region of a note, not the whole thing
motivation: Built for people who keep notes, outlines and drafts in the same file and want to know how long the draft itself is.
problem: Obsidian's word count covers the whole note, so writers who keep outlines and drafts in one file cannot see how long the draft itself is.
summary: Word-count plugin that counts words only in a marked region or under a heading of a note, with timers and an inline count block.
